5. Travelling Allowance.If transferred at the same time or within six months from one and the same old station to one and the same new station in public interest, either may prefer the claim, the other being treated as a member of the family. Only one lumpsum grant will be payable. If a husband or wife is transferred after 60 days of the transfer of the spouse, but within 6 months, 50% of transfer grant is admissible.
